name: A Plague Upon Thee
label: Quest
description: A Plague Upon Thee: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've tried many times to rout out the Scarlet Crusade through force alone, but to no avail. So, as an alternative, I've decided to make their lives more difficult.
If you are willing to help, I want to infest that lumber mill with the most terrible species of termites ever found.

In Plaguewood, near the once-great Stratholme, there is a breed that survived the plague and the Scourge combined. Find their mounds and fill this jar with them, so we can prepare them to be unleashed on the Crusade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the termite mounds, friend? I've heard they are all over Plaguewood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will do nicely, friend. Thank you. Just look at them... So many of them all huddled up. I almost feel bad for the Crusade, but then again, it was never their mill to take, now, was it?
